name: Pipeliners - ePIPE and Goodyear Scripts 2026-06-17
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-06-17

# Summary
Script-only folder from Jun 17, 2026 for two jobs: building a Goodyear-specific FAQ section and finding images with missing alt text on the ePIPE restoration page. No written notes; details come from script comments.

# Key findings
- Goodyear (post 13770): a section cloned from the Phoenix page was adapted with 7 Goodyear-specific questions and answers, the leading Phoenix city image removed and any "Phoenix" text switched to Goodyear. A push script replaced the page's Elementor data (with `wp_slash`) and cleared the Elementor CSS cache.
- ePIPE page (13626): scripts parsed its Elementor data and the media library to list rendered images with empty alt text.
- Note: this predates the later rule against injecting visible Elementor content via WP-CLI.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `_build_goodyear_faq.py`, `push_goodyear.php`, `_parse_epipe_imgs.py`, `_map_alt.py`, `_epipe_alt.sh`, `_more_alt.sh`, `epipe_13626_eldata.json` (Elementor dump).
